multiplexers.reason: tmux leaves the alternate screen at 100×30, the terminal shrinks to 80×24, and then GNU screen enters it. Both emulators keep the alternate screen's 30 rows from before the shrink, so GNU screen's output scrolls 6 of them into its history. A terminal resumed at 80×24 never had those rows, so its alternate screen has no history. Everything else matches, and the alternate screen's history goes when GNU screen leaves it.

resize · narrower after cutting a wide g.reason: Narrowing past a wide glyph leaves its first half in the last column. VT output can't print half a glyph, so the replay leaves that cell blank. A narrower grid then reflows the glyph whole with a plain second half, and a replay can only print a glyph whose halves share its style.
